title: ouratea gillyana
intro: Ouratea gillyana, commonly known as Gillyana, is a plant species belonging to the Opiliaceae family. It is a small, evergreen tree native to the tropical regions of Central and South America, known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Ouratea gillyana include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
